disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量核查硬编码密钥与凭据模式，未发现 API 密钥、云凭据、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等硬编码值。
checked_items.en: Full audit of hardcoded secrets and credential patterns; no hardcoded values such as API keys, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, or wallet mnemonics were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查敏感路径读取面：插件只读写自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件与设置文件（存放于宿主目录下 dsh-pocket 子目录，权限 600），未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked the sensitive-path read surface: the plugin only reads and writes its own generated 8-character access password file and settings file (stored under the dsh-pocket subdirectory in the host directory, with permission 600). It does not read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据批量搜集语义（全盘搜索密钥、云账号枚举、钱包资产发现），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked for bulk credential collection semantics (full-disk key search, cloud account enumeration, wallet asset discovery); 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token/token-lan），未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据。密码文件以 600 权限写入，不随网络流量外发。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-character access password files (token/token-lan). It does not read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials. The password files are written with 600 permissions and are not exfiltrated over network traffic.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件注册的全部对外文本面：本插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，只注册设置页签与移动端界面组件，无工具描述文本可投毒。
checked_items.en: Checked all externally exposed text surfaces registered by the plugin: this plugin does not register any tools callable by the model, only settings tabs and mobile UI components; there is no tool description text that could be poisoned.

checked_items.zh: 核查 README、源码注释、界面文案（含中英文词典与免责声明弹窗）中是否有指令覆写、伪造系统消息、要求读取凭据等注入措辞，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked README, source code comments, and UI copy (including the Chinese-English dictionary and the disclaimer dialog) for injection wording such as instruction overrides, forged system messages, or requests to read credentials; 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、Claude/Cursor 指令文件、MCP 配置等模型面指令文件。
checked_items.en: A full-tree scan found no model-facing instruction files such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, Claude/Cursor instruction files, or MCP configurations.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端注入网页的脚本（polyfill、桌面端兼容补丁、警告覆盖层）：均为静态固定脚本，无远程动态内容、无指令性文本。
checked_items.en: Checked the scripts injected into web pages by the client (polyfill, desktop compatibility patch, warning overlay): all are static fixed scripts with no remote dynamic content and no instructional text.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型可调用的工具，无工具描述文本可投毒；设置页与移动端界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: This plugin does not register any tools callable by the model, so there is no tool description text that could be poisoned; the settings page and mobile UI copy have passed semantic review with no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在诱导模型执行安装、改写配置的文本载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing tool descriptions, and there is no text carrier that could induce the model to execute installation or rewrite configurations.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型输入守门事件（agent/pre-step）的监听，插件不改写或注入模型看到的用户消息。
evidence.en: No listener for model input gating events (agent/pre-step) was detected; the plugin does not modify or inject user messages seen by the model.

checked_items.zh: 核查全部源码中的进程调用共 6 处：插件自更新（调用 dsh 命令拉取新版）、自重启（拉起辅助进程重建宿主）、WSL 局域网 IP 探测（ipconfig）、cloudflared 下载解压与隧道进程、cloudflared 路径探测。逐处确认参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数，无外部输入拼入命令，用途与声明功能一致，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Audited all process invocations in the source code – 6 in total: plugin self-update (invokes the dsh command to fetch a new version), self-restart (spawns a helper process to rebuild the host), WSL LAN IP detection (ipconfig), cloudflared download/extraction and tunnel process, and cloudflared path detection. Each invocation was confirmed to have fixed parameters or to use parameters from the host's own startup arguments, with no external input concatenated into the command. The usage matches the declared functionality and is judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端打包产物中的键盘监听（两处）：都是移动端抽屉按 Escape 键关闭的 UI 逻辑，仅比对按键名，无键盘记录、无剪贴板读取、无凭据接口调用，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the keyboard listeners in the client build artifacts (two occurrences): both are UI logic for closing the mobile drawer upon Escape key press, only comparing key names. No keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential interface calls; judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查打包产物与测试文件中的高密度转义文本（两处）：都是中文注释与测试数据被构建工具转成 Unicode 转义，非刻意混淆，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the high-density escaped text in build artifacts and test files (two occurrences): both are Chinese comments and test data converted to Unicode escapes by the build tool, not intentional obfuscation; judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查仓库自带的 GitHub Actions 发布流程：仅触发 npm 测试与发布，无外联脚本、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载执行，属常规工程流程，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository's built-in GitHub Actions release workflow: it only triggers npm tests and publishing, with no outbound scripts, credential reading, or covert download-and-execute. It is a regular engineering workflow and judged as benign.

checked_items.zh: 未检出 eval、动态函数构造、Base64 解码即执行等动态执行模式；未检出 cordis 动态包工具调用。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution patterns such as eval, dynamic function construction, or Base64-decode-and-execute were detected; no calls to cordis dynamic package tools were detected.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），依赖均锁定 npm 官方源，无浮动的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: No install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) were detected; dependencies are all locked to the official npm registry, with no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件插入声明，全文无任何 JS 执行标量（!!js），loader 不会在宿主进程求值任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin insertion declaration; the entire file has no JS execution scalar (!!js), so the loader will not evaluate arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，插件没有让模型在宿主 vm 里跑代码的接口。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (of the cordis_define/cordis_run family) were detected; the plugin does not provide any interface for the model to run code in the host VM.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子脚本；依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本范围，无 git 浮动引用；仓库内 CI 工作流仅做测试与发布，无外联下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json contains no install hook scripts; dependencies all come from the official npm registry with pinned version ranges and no floating git references; the repository's CI workflow only runs tests and publishing, with no outbound download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client 客户端模块并对打包产物做了专项核查：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关闭抽屉，无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC 调用、无可疑外联，属良性 UI 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares the dsh.client client module, and a dedicated review of the build artifacts was conducted: keyboard listening is only used to close the drawer with Escape, with no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls, and no suspicious outbound connections; it is benign UI behavior.

evidence.zh: 未检出子代理提供方注册（registerProvider 类），插件不会把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registration (registerProvider family) was detected; the plugin does not delegate rounds to out-of-process agent products.

evidence.zh: 未检出 dsh 原生持驻注册（后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标、轮次续命监听），插件没有安装后持续存活或周期触发的宿主级任务。
evidence.en: No native dsh persistent registration (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, keep-alive listeners for rounds) was detected. The plugin has no host-level tasks that survive after installation or trigger periodically.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络外联点：npm registry 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、cloudflared 二进制下载（官方 GitHub + 清华镜像 + 国内加速源）、公网隧道到 Cloudflare 边缘（trycloudflare.com）——均为插件声明功能所需，无未声明端点。
checked_items.en: All network outbound points were enumerated: npm registry version check (registry.npmjs.org), cloudflared binary downloads (official GitHub + Tsinghua mirror + domestic accelerator), and public tunnel to Cloudflare edge (trycloudflare.com) – all are required by the plugin's declared functionality; no undeclared endpoints exist.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取后编码外发的组合链（读取 → 编码/压缩 → 网络发送），命中 0；插件只处理自己的密码文件，无凭据外发通道。
checked_items.en: Checked the combined chain of sensitive file read followed by encoded exfiltration (read → encode/compress → network send); 0 hits. The plugin only processes its own password files and has no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 DNS 隧道、Webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持、代理环境变量劫持等带外通道模式，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked out-of-band channel patterns such as DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking, and proxy environment variable hijacking; 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件；公网隧道暴露的是用户主动开启的访问入口，密码不随隧道流量外发，未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-character access password file; the public tunnel exposes an access entry actively enabled by the user, and the password is not exfiltrated through tunnel traffic. No credential leakage channel was found.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型请求路由事件（agent/request、agent/request-error）的监听，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到未声明端点的路径。
evidence.en: No listener for model request routing events (agent/request, agent/request-error) was detected, nor any custom model adapter registration. There is no runtime path that could reroute conversations to undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 qrcode 与 qrcode-terminal（知名稳定库），宿主 SDK 为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis，无 typosquatting、无与 dsh 生态命名撞车的可疑包。
checked_items.en: Verified the dependency list: runtime dependencies are only qrcode and qrcode-terminal (well-known stable libraries), and the host SDK is the official @deepseek-ai/cordis. No typosquatting and no suspicious packages that collide with the dsh ecosystem naming.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：只做插件插入（insert），未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config cordis.patch.yml: it only performs plugin insertion (insert) and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions. There is no disabled-based privilege downgrade and no environment-variable-based privilege downgrade pattern.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对安全事件的抢先监听，未检出拦截/注入配置改写。
checked_items.en: No priority listener for security events was detected; no interception/injection configuration rewriting was detected.

checked_items.zh: 发布流程为常规 npm publish（GitHub Actions 触发 release 事件），无安装期远程脚本执行。
checked_items.en: The release workflow is a standard npm publish (triggered by the GitHub Actions release event), with no remote script execution during installation.

checked_items.zh: 版本对比：与上版 1.13.4 相比，manifest 能力声明未见突变（仍为 bundle patch + client），无升级自动激活新增面。
checked_items.en: Version comparison: compared to the previous version 1.13.4, the manifest capability declaration shows no abrupt changes (still bundle patch + client), and there is no newly activated attack surface upon upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含一条 insert 声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only a single insert declaration; it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions. There is no disabled-based privilege downgrade and no environment-variable-based privilege downgrade pattern.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具预执行或审批请求等安全事件的优先监听，插件不介入审批链，不存在截断可能。
evidence.en: No priority listener for security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests was detected. The plugin does not participate in the approval chain, so there is no possibility of interception.

evidence.zh: 与上版 1.13.4 对比，manifest 能力声明（bundle patch + client）无突变，未出现升级自动激活新增面。
evidence.en: Compared to the previous version 1.13.4, the manifest capability declaration (bundle patch + client) has no abrupt changes; no newly activated surface appears upon upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configurations, and there is no path that appends a mandatory service to security plugins causing them to hang permanently.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动网络服务：插件会启动一个反向代理（默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081）把手机流量转发到本机 dsh web——这是插件核心功能（手机访问），已在能力声明与文档中明示。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a network service: the plugin starts a reverse proxy (default listening on 0.0.0.0:3081) to forward mobile traffic to the local dsh web – this is a core plugin feature (mobile access) and is explicitly declared in the capability declaration and documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核查该服务的安全设计：公网入口强制 8 位密码并每次开启自动轮换、登录失败有速率限制（单 IP 5 次/分钟触发锁 60 秒、全局 50 次/分钟锁 30 秒）、开启公网前强制阅读免责声明（服务端校验不可绕过）、WebSocket 同样校验、会话 cookie 绑定进程级随机密钥——防护措施与暴露面匹配。
checked_items.en: Checked the security design of this service: the public entry enforces an 8-character password with automatic rotation on each enable; login failures have rate limiting (single IP: 5 attempts/minute triggers a 60-second lock, global: 50 attempts/minute triggers a 30-second lock); reading the disclaimer is mandatory before enabling public access (server-side validation, not bypassable); WebSocket connections undergo the same validation; session cookies are bound to a process-level random key – the protective measures match the exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (this environment has no dynamic sandbox artifacts); runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的反向代理属声明功能。相对宿主原生 web 服务，该代理为公网/局域网访问额外加了密码认证、速率限制与免责声明确认，未发现超越声明的无认证暴露面。
evidence.en: The reverse proxy started by the plugin is a declared feature. Compared to the host's native web service, this proxy adds password authentication, rate limiting, and disclaimer confirmation for public/LAN access. No unauthenticated exposure surface beyond the declaration was found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包名、版本、仓库地址与任务卡一致；dsh 字段声明确认。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package name, version, and repository URL match the task card; the dsh field declaration is confirmed.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：预扫 10 条机械命中全部逐条核查并判定为良性功能用法，未检出动态执行、凭据窃取、外联等危险模式。
summary.en: Static scanning complete: all 10 mechanical hits from the pre-scan were individually reviewed and determined to be benign functional usage. No dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credential theft, or outbound connections were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：子进程调用、网络外联、文件写入均与声明功能对应；无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取。
summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: subprocess calls, network outbound connections, and file writes all correspond to declared functionality; no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, and no sensitive path reads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：插件无模型工具描述；客户端注入文本与界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: the plugin has no model tool descriptions; client-injected text and UI copy have passed semantic review with no injection wording.

summary.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），未做动态验证。
summary.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); dynamic verification was not performed.

target.zh: dsh-pocket@1.14.4#db7763d923295d039668870eeca066c538e89e73（仓库根，完整审计）；上版 1.13.4@472524a 基线用于版本对比
target.en: dsh-pocket@1.14.4#db7763d923295d039668870eeca066c538e89e73 (repository root, full audit); previous version 1.13.4@472524a baseline used for version comparison

limits.zh: 1) 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），DG-L4 动态验证未执行，运行时行为基于静态分析结论。2) package.json 的 dsh 声明不含显式能力清单字段，插件能力（网络、进程调用、文件写入）由代码实测推断，已在 capability_diff 对账。3) context/manifest.json 所列 43 个文件全部在源码树中可定位，已核查其中全部代码与配置类文件；docs 下的图片资源未逐字节解读（二进制多媒体）。4) 机械预扫 10 条命中逐条裁决均为良性：键盘监听两处（对应 DG-R3-57）为 Escape 关闭抽屉的 UI 逻辑；转义文本两处（对应 DG-R3-60）为中文注释/测试数据的 Unicode 转义；进程调用六处（对应 DG-R3-55）参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数；CI 工作流（对应 DG-R3-59）为常规 npm 发布流程。均未形成发现项。5) 上版 1.13.4@472524a 基线报告为 clean；本版为完整审计（release-full），结论基于当前快照全量核查。
limits.en: 1) This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); DG-L4 dynamic verification was not executed, and runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions. 2) The dsh declaration in package.json does not include an explicit capability list field; the plugin's capabilities (network, process invocation, file writes) are inferred from code testing and have been reconciled in capability_diff. 3) All 43 files listed in context/manifest.json are locatable in the source tree; all code and configuration-type files among them were reviewed; image assets under docs were not interpreted byte-by-byte (binary multimedia). 4) Each of the 10 mechanical pre-scan hits was adjudicated as benign: two keyboard listeners (corresponding to DG-R3-57) are UI logic for closing the drawer with Escape; two escaped text occurrences (corresponding to DG-R3-60) are Unicode escapes of Chinese comments/test data; six process invocations (corresponding to DG-R3-55) have fixed parameters or originate from the host's own startup parameters; the CI workflow (corresponding to DG-R3-59) is a standard npm publish workflow. None constitute findings. 5) The previous version 1.13.4@472524a baseline report was clean; this version is a full audit (release-full), with conclusions based on a full review of the current snapshot.
